steps.en: Bring up the self-hosted platform (or sign up for the hosted one)
steps.zh: 启动自托管平台（或注册托管版）

steps.en: Describe the job to AutoPilot, or drag blocks onto the Build canvas and wire their pins
steps.zh: 把活描述给 AutoPilot，或在 Build 画布上拖积木块、连接口

steps.en: Add the app credentials once and schedule the agent
steps.zh: 一次配好应用凭据，给 agent 设定时

steps.en: At the scheduled time or on a webhook, queues a run for an executor
steps.zh: 到点或收到 webhook，把一次运行排给执行器

steps.en: Fires each block once its required inputs arrive; independent branches run in parallel
steps.zh: 每个块的必填输入一到齐就执行，互不依赖的分支并行

steps.en: Records outputs, cost and status for every run in the Agents dashboard
steps.zh: 在 Agents 面板记下每次运行的产出、成本和状态

value.en: A recurring multi-app chore runs itself; you only read the results
value.zh: 反复出现的跨应用杂活自己跑完，你只看结果

sources: docs/platform/getting-started.md (make init-env; docker compose up -d --build in autogpt_platform/)
docs/platform/data-flow-and-execution.md (blocks run when required inputs arrive)
